title: Perfect complexes generate the quasi-coherent derived category
statement: For every quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme X [def-pc-scheme], the smallest strictly full subcategory of D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X) [def-pc-derived-category] that contains every perfect complex [def-pc-perfect-complex] and is closed under shifts, cones, retracts, and arbitrary set-indexed direct sums is all of D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X).

proof.text: For an affine scheme X = Spec(A), O_X is a perfect object of D_QCoh(O_X) and a perfect generator: E = 0 exactly when Hom(O_X[n], E) vanishes for every n.

Let X be quasi-compact and quasi-separated with X = U union V, U quasi-compact open and V affine open, and let P be a perfect generator of D_QCoh(O_U). The cited induction step gives a perfect Q on X and a perfect Koszul object K' supported on V minus U such that Q direct-sum K' is a generator of D_QCoh(O_X); a direct sum of two perfect objects is perfect (on a common refinement of the two coverings the sum of two strictly perfect complexes is strictly perfect), so D_QCoh(O_X) has a single perfect generator.

For the qcqs scheme X, let P(W), for a quasi-compact open W of X, be the property that D_QCoh(O_W) has a perfect generator, i.e. a perfect object G with E = 0 if and only if Hom(G[n], E) = 0 for all n, for every E in D_QCoh(O_W). P holds for every affine open by Step 1. If U is quasi-compact open, V affine open and P(U) holds, then U union V is a quasi-compact open of the quasi-separated X, hence itself quasi-compact and quasi-separated, and Step 2 applied to U union V gives P(U union V). By the induction principle, P(X) holds: D_QCoh(O_X) has a perfect generator G.

Let S be the smallest strictly full subcategory of D_QCoh(O_X) containing every perfect complex and closed under shifts, cones, retracts and set-indexed direct sums. D_QCoh(O_X) is triangulated with set-indexed direct sums by lem-pc-derived-qcoh-direct-sums, and G is compact by lem-pc-perfect-object-compact; the one-member family (G) has coproduct G, which is a generator in the sense of def-pc-generators (a nonzero K has Hom(G[-n], K) nonzero for some n, i.e. a nonzero map G -> K[n]). By lem-pc-compact-generators-build-objects every object Y of D_QCoh(O_X) sits in a triangle (sum_n X_n) -> (sum_n X_n) -> Y -> with X_1 a direct sum of shifts of G and X_{n+1} the cone of a map Z_n -> X_n with Z_n a direct sum of shifts of G. Shifts of G are perfect, so X_1 and every Z_n lie in S; by induction every X_n lies in S, hence the direct sum of the X_n and its cone Y lie in S. Thus S is all of D_QCoh(O_X).
